title: Last Patient Home

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: a train crash near Toledo kills 68, Kharkiv burns, Ethiopians flee into Kenya, and the Iran war grinds on. But a DR Congo Ebola centre cheers its last patient home, and a Kiribati fisherman is found after 41 days adrift.

style.genre: trip-hop — Rhodes, vibraphone, fretless bass, SP-1200

lines: Two trains met in the Toledo dark,
A strait wound on a seven-day clock,
a beaten man crowned on foreign ground,
Ring it out at the clinic door,
and a boy, forty-one days adrift,
pulled home again from the open sea.
